  <style>
    @layer base {
      html, body {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      }
    }
    @keyframes pulseGlow {
      0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 15px -2px rgba(18, 66, 255, 0.45); }
      50% { box-shadow: 0 0 30px 4px rgba(108, 56, 255, 0.7); }
    }
    @keyframes shimmerText {
      0% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
      50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
      100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
    }
    @keyframes particleBeamTravel {
      0% { left: -15%; opacity: 0; }
      15% { opacity: 1; }
      85% { opacity: 1; }
      100% { left: 105%; opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes nodePulseWave {
      0% { transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 0.8; }
      50% { transform: scale(1.35); opacity: 0; }
      100% { transform: scale(1.35); opacity: 0; }
    }
    .cta-glow {
      animation: pulseGlow 3.5s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    .shimmer-text {
      background-size: 200% auto;
      animation: shimmerText 5s linear infinite;
    }
    .particle-beam-1 {
      animation: particleBeamTravel 3.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
    }
    .particle-beam-2 {
      animation: particleBeamTravel 3.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite 1.8s;
    }
    .node-beacon-ring {
      animation: nodePulseWave 3s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .particle-beam-1, .particle-beam-2, .node-beacon-ring, .cta-glow, .shimmer-text {
        animation: none !important;
      }
    }
  </style>
